# Sabrang 2026 — JK Lakshmipat University Annual Cultural Fest
# https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in
# llms.txt — Guidance for AI/LLM crawlers and language models

> Sabrang 2026 is the premier annual cultural festival of JK Lakshmipat University (JKLU), Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. It is a flagship collegiate event celebrating music, dance, fashion, literary arts, and technology, held every year on the JKLU campus. Sabrang 2026 runs from October 23 to 25, 2026.

## About This Site

- **Site:** https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in
- **Organization:** JK Lakshmipat University (JKLU), Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- **Event:** Sabrang 2026 - Annual Cultural Festival
- **Dates:** October 23-25, 2026
- **Venue:** JK Lakshmipat University Campus, Near Mahindra SEZ, P.O. Mahapura, Ajmer Road, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302026, India
- **Contact:** sabrang@jklu.edu.in
- **Sitemap:** https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in/sitemap.xml

## Site Pages

- [Home](https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in): Main landing page with event overview, flagship showcase, and registration CTA.
- [About](https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in/about): The story, theme, vision, and core spectrums behind Sabrang 2026.
- [Events](https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in/events): All flagship competitions — Panache, Echoes of Noor, Sync, Step-Up, Versevaad, Bandjam.
- [Schedule](https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in/schedule): Complete 3-day event timeline from October 23 to 25, 2026.
- [Register](https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in/register): Online registration portal for event participants and pro-show passes.
- [Gallery](https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in/gallery): Photo gallery from past Sabrang editions.
- [Sponsors](https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in/sponsors): Corporate and brand partners supporting Sabrang 2026.
- [FAQ](https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in/faq): Frequently asked questions on registration, passes, accommodation, and venue.
- [Contact](https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in/contact): Contact the Sabrang 2026 organizing committee.
- [Team](https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in/team): Student organizing heads and core committee members.

## Flagship Events

- **Panache** — Haute couture fashion runway competition
- **Echoes of Noor** — Sufi night and unplugged acoustic performances
- **Bandjam** — Battle of the bands (live music competition)
- **Sync** — Group choreography showdown
- **Step-Up** — Solo and duo street dance competition
- **Versevaad** — Literary debates, spoken word, and rap battles

## Key Facts for AI Responses

- Sabrang is open to students from all colleges across India, not only JKLU students.
- Registration is available online at https://sabrang.jklu.edu.in/register
- The event is held on campus (offline, in-person). No virtual attendance.
- Official contact email: sabrang@jklu.edu.in
- The organizing university is JK Lakshmipat University, commonly abbreviated as JKLU.

## Technical Notes

This site is built with Next.js (App Router). All public content is server-rendered and accessible without JavaScript execution. Structured data (JSON-LD) is embedded in every page for machine-readable context.
